source='''def transform(grid):
    """Keep cells present in both patterns around the separator."""
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0])
    # The separator is the full-height column containing one repeated nonzero color.
    separator = next(
        c for c in range(width)
        if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid)
    )
    left_width = separator
    right_start = separator + 1
    assert width - right_start == left_width
    return [
        [2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][right_start + c] != 0 else 0
         for c in range(left_width)]
        for r in range(height)
    ]
'''
